actions.action: Perform thermography inspections to identify hot spots and potential short circuits in wiring, especially after rainy conditions.
actions.expected_impact: Early detection of wiring degradation and short circuits, addressing the failure mode which accounts for 38.1% of the equipment cost and has one recurrence within 90 days.

actions.action: Conduct IV-curve tracing and insulation resistance tests to verify electrical integrity of the PV strings and identify degradation or insulation issues.
actions.expected_impact: Improved reliability of wiring and reduced risk of short circuits, targeting the failure mode responsible for the highest cost share and recurrences.

actions.action: Implement a regular cleaning schedule for modules to prevent dirt accumulation, especially after moderate rain events, to mitigate contamination.
actions.expected_impact: Reduction in performance loss and failures caused by surface contamination, which represents 25.9% of the equipment cost and has one recurrence within 90 days.

actions.action: Check and tighten connector torque during scheduled maintenance to prevent connector failures caused by environmental wear.
actions.expected_impact: Decrease in connector failures and associated costs, addressing the failure mode with a 6.4% cost share and recurrent incidents.

actions.action: Inspect surge protection devices and grounding to prevent electrical surges from rain or storms from triggering chain and junction box failures.

actions.expected_impact: Reduced risk of severe electrical failures triggered by environmental factors, despite a lower cost share and no recent recurrence.

actions.expected_impact: Minimized fire risk, maintaining safety standards, with no severe incidents reported.

actions.expected_impact: Faster repair response and reduced downtime, especially for the failure mode with the highest recurrence and cost share.
